transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI is retiring Custom GPTs and moving to a plugin architecture for ChatGPT and Codex. Reported by THE Journal: Technological Horizons in Education.
Aventra Group has unveiled a pioneering ISO 42001 artificial intelligence framework to speed up enterprise artificial intelligence adoption in APAC. Confirmed by ZAWYA.
Record-breaking artificial intelligence chip financing is entering its distribution phase, with 42 billion dollars in senior debt backed by Broadcom's credit and 18 billion dollars in subordinated debt awaiting Anthropic's IPO. Reported by 富途牛牛.
Kling, an artificial intelligence video startup, has picked banks for a 1 billion-plus dollar IPO. Reported by Bloomberg.
Free every hour.
